concerns.text: US-1 acceptance scenario 2 ('a clip with high-variance latent trajectories... variance metric is > 2x the variance of a low-variance clip') has no task or verification step. T003/T004 verify only column presence and non-nulls. Add a check (e.g., in T003's verification) comparing a known high-variance clip against a stable one.

Plan's rationale claims 'explicit power analysis, and stratified sampling' as part of the statistical approach, but no task implements either. Either add a task (e.g., extend T009/T013) or the plan element is uncovered — an implementer cannot satisfy the stated statistical rigor.

concerns.location: tasks.md:T012 vs constitution.md:Data Hygiene / Principle V
concerns.text: Constitution requires every file under data/ to be checksummed in state/projects/PROJ-971-...yaml's artifact_hashes map, but T012 mandates the hash manifest live 'under code/reports/hash_manifest.txt — never under state/'. No task records hashes in the state yaml, leaving the constitution requirement uncovered.

FR-006 also requires 'ensuring no GPU dependencies are invoked'; T010 monitors only runtime and RAM. Add a GPU-invocation check (e.g., assert torch.cuda.is_available() is never used / CUDA device never requested) to T010's scope.

Plan specifies contract tests test_descriptor_schema.py and test_validation_results_schema.py; only T005 adds a label-schema test. No task creates the descriptor/validation-results contract tests — add them to T003/T008 or note the deviation.
